subject: CPA Small Grant Funding Limit Increase
overview: The committee recommended a restoration grant for veteran headstones and proposed significant policy changes to the Community Preservation Act application process. Key revisions include doubling the small grant award limit to $10,000 and removing the mandatory matching requirement for those grants.

items.title: Cross Street Cemetery Headstone Restoration
items.summary: Recommended $5,000 for the restoration of approximately 15 veteran headstones at the Cross Street Cemetery.

items.title: FY26 Application Materials Review
items.summary: Reviewed and proposed edits to the Eligibility Determination Form and full application to simplify the process for city departments and include specific consent requirements for condominium associations.

items.title: Preservation Restrictions and Covenants
items.summary: Discussed the legal hurdles of recording permanent preservation restrictions and considered adopting term-limited covenants to accelerate project funding.

items.title: Small Grant Funding Policy
items.summary: Proposed increasing the maximum award for small grants from $5,000 to $10,000 and removing the mandatory matching requirement to make the funds more accessible.

items.title: Community Celebration Event Planning
items.summary: Discussed plans for an April 26 community celebration at Riverbend Park to showcase CPA-funded projects through walking tours and family-oriented activities.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from January 2025.
